SELECT nc.type AS name, COUNT(n.id) AS count FROM novel_category nc LEFT JOIN novel_category_relation ncr ON nc.id = ncr.category_id LEFT JOIN novel n ON ncr.novel_id = n.id AND n.is_del = 0 GROUP BY nc.id, nc.type ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT CASE nc.category WHEN 1 THEN '男频' WHEN 2 THEN '女频' END AS name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS count FROM novel_category nc LEFT JOIN novel_category_relation ncr ON nc.id = ncr.category_id LEFT JOIN novel n ON ncr.novel_id = n.id AND n.is_del = 0 GROUP BY nc.category ORDER BY nc.category ASC
SELECT CASE is_finished WHEN 0 THEN '连载中' WHEN 1 THEN '已完结' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM novel WHERE is_del = 0 GROUP BY is_finished ORDER BY is_finished ASC
SELECT CASE is_hot WHEN 0 THEN '普通' WHEN 1 THEN '热门' END AS name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM novel WHERE is_del = 0 GROUP BY is_hot ORDER BY is_hot DESC

SELECT rank, CASE rank WHEN 1 THEN '执笔者' WHEN 2 THEN '织梦师' WHEN 3 THEN '造界者' WHEN 4 THEN '渡舟人' WHEN 5 THEN '燃灯者' END AS rankName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM author WHERE is_del = 0 GROUP BY rank ORDER BY rank ASC

SELECT vip_level AS vipLevel, CASE vip_level WHEN 0 THEN '普通用户' WHEN 1 THEN 'VIP1' WHEN 2 THEN 'VIP2' WHEN 3 THEN 'VIP3' WHEN 4 THEN '金主' END AS vipName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM visitor WHERE is_del = 0 GROUP BY vip_level ORDER BY vip_level ASC

SELECT id, name, author_name AS authorName, chapter_count AS chapterCount, is_finished AS isFinished, is_hot AS isHot, url, DATE_FORMAT(update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS updateTime FROM novel WHERE is_del = 0 AND is_finished = 0 ORDER BY chapter_count DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, name, rank AS authorRank, CASE rank WHEN 1 THEN '执笔者' WHEN 2 THEN '织梦师' WHEN 3 THEN '造界者' WHEN 4 THEN '渡舟人' WHEN 5 THEN '燃灯者' END AS rankName, novel_count AS novelCount, avatar FROM author WHERE is_del = 0 AND novel_count > 0 ORDER BY novel_count DESC, update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM novel WHERE is_del = 0 AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT CONCAT(YEAR(create_time), '-W', LPAD(WEEK(create_time, 1), 2, '0')) AS date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM novel WHERE is_del = 0 AND DATE(create_time) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY YEAR(create_time), WEEK(create_time, 1) ORDER BY date ASC
